fnol_text: My name is Owen Quinlan and I live at 775 Rowan Way, Clinton, NC 28325. You can reach me on (555) 503-3652 or owen.quinlan@example.com. On 10 August 2026 another car pulled out of a side road and hit my front passenger side. The other driver, Lucia Zielinski, admitted they didn't see me. Policy MT-2023-00026. I'd like to claim for the damage to my car.

adjuster_notes.text: Called Mrs Quinlan on (555) 503-3652 to acknowledge the claim. Owen confirmed the loss date as 10 August 2026.
Vehicle inspected at the repairer. Witness Dmitri Vasquez gave a statement by phone.
Third-party driver Lucia Zielinski reports lower back strain and attended Mercy General. Owen reports a sprained ankle.
